elements.element: Customer is not subject to any non-compete restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still prohibits the Company from participating in any Internet project similar to the Site with respect to Deerskin Products.

elements.element: Customer is not subject to any field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still gives HDI the exclusive right to use the “Deerskin” brand for a self-contained direct-to-consumer website, restricting the Company’s use of that brand in the specified online channel.

elements.element: Any restriction is limited to a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to “Deerskin Products”; the references to substantially similar products and other named companies’ products were removed.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly applies “during the term of this Agreement” and contains no post-termination restriction.

elements.element: The restriction is capped at 12 months.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 states that the restriction applies “in any event for no longer than 12 months.”

elements.element: The restriction contains a carve-out for Customer’s internal development.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph states that Section 6.1 does not apply to the Company’s internal development of websites or e-commerce capabilities.

elements.element: The restriction contains a carve-out for acquisitions.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph states that Section 6.1 does not apply to any business or website acquired by the Company.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because operative non-compete and online field-of-use restrictions remain. It satisfies every fallback element by narrowing the covered products, limiting the restriction to the term and no more than 12 months, and adding internal-development and acquisition carve-outs. The changes are targeted and leave the closeout-merchandise exception and other commercial terms intact, although the 12-month cap could be clearer about its commencement date.
